title: Web Scraper Source
description: Run-once web scraping source built on BeautifulSoup. Needs no input, so it can start a scheduled deployment.
Configure sources as JSON: public JSON APIs (GET or POST, with dot-path field mapping), RSS/Atom feeds, or HTML listing pages (CSS selectors). Each source becomes one pipeline object.

Emits every item of a source as one JSON row list on the answers lane (wire it to a SQL node to load a table; each row carries a url_hash dedup key) and as one text document per item on the text lane.
Only public hosts are reachable: every request and redirect hop is re-validated, responses are size-capped, and requests to the same host are paced.

scraper.sources.title: Sources (JSON)
scraper.sources.description: JSON array of sources. Each: name, kind (json | feed | html), url or urls (string or {url, name, extra}), optional platform, method (GET/POST, json only), headers, body (POST JSON), itemsPath (json), itemSelector (html), fields (output field -> dot path for json, CSS selector[@attr] for html; value may be a list of fallbacks), maxItems, extra (static columns), enabled. URLs, headers and bodies may use {today}, {now}, {days_ago:N}, {hours_ago:N}, {unix_days_ago:N}, {unix_hours_ago:N} (epoch seconds), {per_url}, {max}. Secrets: use ${ROCKETRIDE_*} variables in headers.

scraper.maxItemsPerSource.title: Max items per source
scraper.maxItemsPerSource.description: Default cap for sources that do not set maxItems (split evenly across a source's URLs).

scraper.maxResponseKB.title: Max response size (KB)
scraper.maxResponseKB.description: Response bodies are read up to this size; anything beyond is dropped and the result is marked truncated.

scraper.requestIntervalMs.title: Delay between requests to one host (ms)
scraper.requestIntervalMs.description: Politeness pacing: minimum gap between two requests to the same host. 0 disables pacing.

scraper.maxBodyChars.title: Max item body characters
scraper.maxBodyChars.description: Item bodies are trimmed to this many characters.

scraper.userAgent.title: User agent
scraper.userAgent.description: User-Agent header sent with every request. Leave blank for the default. Some sites (e.g. Reddit) reject generic agents.

scraper.allowPattern.title: URL pattern (regex)
scraper.allowPattern.description: Python regex searched against the full URL, e.g. ^https://news\.ycombinator\.com/

scraper.urlAllowList.title: URL allow-list
scraper.urlAllowList.description: Optional. When one or more patterns are set, a URL (and every redirect target) must match at least one. Empty allows every public URL; private and local addresses are always blocked.
